cells.gaps: No ruling of the authority against a named organisation in the last three years has been found. A decree of 16 October 2026 named the president of the regulator formed by merging the commission with the communication council; whether its other members are appointed is not known.
cells.note: Stage 3: the commission was appointed and at work in 2026, and the merged regulator's president was named by decree on 16 October 2026. No ruling against a named organisation is held, so stage 4 is not met.
